blocks.text: KUWAIT CITY, Kuwait — Gulf nations scrambled to intercept incoming fire from Iran and its allies on Wednesday after the US struck an Iranian island, as rising violence threatened efforts to resolve the Middle East war. Kuwait activated its air defenses to counter drone strikes — the first since early September — and Bahrain said it had fended off an Iranian attack after the United States struck Iran’s Qeshm Island in the flashpoint Strait of Hormuz.
